home.bio.title|en:
Tee Moon is a Ukrainian fine art photographer based in Maryland, USA. She studied at the Kyiv School of Photography in 2020.

Her work is driven by curiosity and experimentation, exploring photography as a medium of observation, expression, and discovery.
home.cv.p.1|en:
Tee Moon (Tetiana Sulima) is a visual artist and photographer based in the United States. Born in Ukraine, she began her fine art practice after graduating from the Kyiv School of Photography, where she developed a strong foundation in composition and visual perception.


Her work explores light, color, and form through a minimalist and experimental approach. Moving beyond photography, she incorporates mixed media elements such as wood, sculptural forms, and cyanotype, examining the subtle transformation of image and material.


In 2022, she participated in the group exhibition “Through the Prism of Time” in Ukraine. Her practice continues to evolve through ongoing study of contemporary photography and color theory, focusing on quiet visual tension and refined simplicity.

s1.intro|en:
Awake explores the moment when a woman begins to emerge from the roles and expectations imposed upon her.
Fragments of the body intertwine with the structured lines of a man's suit, creating a surreal form suspended between concealment and self-expression.
She is no longer merely the one being looked at. She looks back.
Playful yet unsettling, the image reflects a quiet act of resistance — the awakening of a presence that refuses to remain unseen.


Digital Photomontage

prints.p.1|en:
Each photograph is an invitation to pause and discover beauty in the details we often overlook. From quiet landscapes to unexpected shapes, colors, and textures, these images capture fleeting moments and reveal the extraordinary within the ordinary.


Selected works are available as fine art prints, bringing a sense of wonder, stillness, and individuality into your space.
artist.text|en:
My artistic practice begins with curiosity — a desire to look beyond the familiar and discover unexpected meanings in ordinary things.

Through photography and mixed media, I explore the relationships between light, color, texture, and form. I am drawn to subtle details, unusual perspectives, and the moments when familiar objects become something entirely different.

Experimentation is an essential part of my process. I enjoy challenging conventional ways of seeing, allowing materials, shapes, and unexpected visual connections to suggest new interpretations.

Rather than offering definitive answers, I invite viewers to pause, look closer, and discover their own associations and emotions within the work.
s1.intro|uk:
«Пробудження» досліджує момент, коли жінка починає вивільнятися з ролей та очікувань, нав’язаних їй ззовні.
Фрагменти тіла переплітаються зі строгими лініями чоловічого костюма, створюючи сюрреалістичну форму, що балансує між приховуванням і самовираженням.
Вона більше не є лише об’єктом погляду. Тепер вона дивиться у відповідь.
Цей образ — грайливий, але водночас тривожний — відображає тихий акт спротиву: пробудження сутності, яка більше не бажає залишатися непоміченою.
Цифровий фотомонтаж
